responsibility: Provides the target-specific RTL operand predicates used by the Xstormy16 machine description to recognize legal instruction operands and comparison forms. In addition to generic operator classifiers for shifts and comparison kinds, it defines predicates for the backend’s special below100 memory area, register-or-memory combinations used by byte operations, one-bit set/clear immediates, non-stack nonimmediate operands that exclude push/pop forms, and carry-sensitive arithmetic shapes that guide pattern matching and peephole selection in stormy16.md.
